project_id: Big League Smart Contract Audit Report - QuillAudits

violation_target.vulnerability_type: Denial of Service via Fee Processing

preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some amount of the token (BGLG) to initiate transfer
Contract must have accumulated fee tokens in its balance (balanceOf[address(this)]) that meet or exceed the swap threshold
Contract must have zero or insufficient BNB balance to complete the addLiquidityETH call

violation_target.exploit_hint: Trigger a transfer to the pair address (which has isPair set to true) when the contract has accumulated fee tokens above the swap threshold but insufficient BNB balance. This will cause _sellAndDistributeAccumulatedTKNFee() to execute, which will attempt to add liquidity via addLiquidityETH with the contract's entire BNB balance. If the contract has zero BNB, the call will revert, causing the entire transfer to fail. Repeatedly trigger this condition to create a persistent denial of service for transfers to the pair.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The vulnerability exists in _sellAndDistributeAccumulatedTKNFee() which calls addLiquidityETH with the contract's entire BNB balance. If the contract has zero BNB, this call reverts, causing the entire transfer to fail. This creates a DoS condition for transfers to pair addresses when fee tokens have accumulated above the threshold.
attempts.attack_strategy: 1. Acquire BGLG tokens. 2. Make transfers to pair to accumulate fee tokens in contract. 3. Ensure contract has zero BNB balance. 4. Trigger transfer to pair when contract's token balance exceeds swap threshold, causing revert in addLiquidityETH.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Use deal() to give attacker BGLG tokens. 2. Impersonate owner to ensure attacker not blacklisted. 3. Calculate swap threshold amount. 4. Make transfers to pair to accumulate fees until contract balance ≥ threshold. 5. Check/ensure contract BNB balance is zero. 6. Trigger final transfer to pair to cause DoS revert.
